title: The Tilted Sampling Problem: Optimism, Posterior Sampling, and Logarithmic Regret
abstract: arXiv:2610.21908v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many modern learning systems are used not to select a single best action, but to sample diverse high-quality outputs. Examples include entropy-regularized reinforcement learning, RLHF, and reward-guided generative modeling. Motivated by these settings, we study tilted sampling: an online learning problem in which the goal is to sample from the Gibbs distribution induced by an unknown reward function. We define sampling regret as the temperature-normalized cumulative KL divergence between the learner's distribution and the Gibbs target, corresponding to the suboptimality gap in entropy-regularized reward maximization. Our framework generalizes recent sampling-based and KL-regularized formulations in bandits and reinforcement learning. Our main contribution is a general regret framework that captures the different uncertainty structure of tilted sampling and classical regret minimization. translated_title: 倾斜采样问题：乐观原理、后验采样与对数遗憾
translated_abstract: 许多现代学习系统的用途并非选择单一最优动作，而是采样多样化的高质量输出，例如熵正则化强化学习、RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）以及奖励引导的生成建模。受这些场景启发，我们研究了倾斜采样：一个在线学习问题，其目标是从由未知奖励函数诱导的吉布斯分布中进行采样。我们将采样遗憾定义为学习者的分布与吉布斯目标分布之间经温度归一化的累积KL散度，它对应于熵正则化奖励最大化中的次优性差距。我们的框架推广了赌博机和强化学习中近期基于采样的以及KL正则化的多种表述。我们的主要贡献是一个通用的遗憾框架，它刻画了倾斜采样与经典遗憾最小化之间不同的不确定性结构。虽然标准遗憾的量级为 $\widetilde{O}(\sqr...（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了倾斜采样这一在线学习问题，以温度归一化累积KL散度定义采样遗憾，并构建了一个通用遗憾框架，揭示倾斜采样与经典遗憾最小化具有不同的不确定性结构，借助乐观原理和后验采样可将对数级遗憾推广至从未知奖励诱导的吉布斯分布中采样的场景。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the tilted sampling problem—online learning of sampling from the Gibbs distribution induced by an unknown reward—defines sampling regret as temperature-normalized cumulative KL divergence, and presents a general regret framework showing that optimism and posterior sampling achieve logarithmic regret in settings structurally different from classical regret minimization.
